buys.item: Lunch at a dhaba: dal, rice, roti

answer.thought: The hunger is no longer a suggestion but a demand, a particular need that the universal spirit has ignored for too long. I shall eat, not merely to sustain the body, but to reassert the unity of the rational and the organic. The dhaba food is humble, but it is the actuality of nourishment here.
